paragraphs.text: Have you ever considered making ice cream at home but thought it would be too complicated? Here is a selection of machines that could change your mind
paragraphs.translation:
你是否曾考虑过在家制作冰淇淋，但又觉得这太复杂了？
这里有一系列机器，它们或许能改变你的想法。

paragraphs.text: A Magimix Gelato Expert
paragraphs.translation: A Magimix Gelato Expert

paragraphs.text: If you’re an ice cream fanatic, it doesn’t get better than this. It’s quick, taking as little as 20 minutes, and consistent in its results, while the three automated programmes are very easy to use and it has an unusually generous two-litre capacity. On the other hand, we found it noisier than many, and the ice cream is softer than we might have liked.
paragraphs.translation:
如果你是一个冰淇淋狂热爱好者，这款产品无可匹敌。
它速度快，仅需20分钟即可完成，结果稳定，同时三个自动程序非常易于操作，并且拥有异常宽裕的两升容量。
另一方面，我们发现它比许多同类产品更嘈杂，且制作的冰淇淋比我们预期的要软一些。

paragraphs.text: B Shake n Make Ice Cream Maker
paragraphs.translation: B 摇晃即得冰淇淋机

paragraphs.text: If you want to make some basic soft ice cream, this is a fun little gadget that gets decent results. You add a little ice and salt to the base, then your ingredients to the stainless-steel tub, pop the lid on and give it a good shake for at least three minutes. Provided you measure everything exactly and shake back and forth consistently, it’s surprisingly efficient.
paragraphs.translation:
如果你想制作一些基本的软冰淇淋，这是一个有趣的小工具，能获得不错的效果。
你在底座上加一点冰和盐，然后将食材放入不锈钢桶中，盖上盖子，用力摇晃至少三分钟。
只要你准确测量所有材料并持续来回摇晃，它的效率令人惊讶。

paragraphs.text: C Sage Smart Scoop
paragraphs.translation: C 款 Sage Smart Scoop 智能冰激凌机

paragraphs.text: This is a seriously smart machine. Our favourite feature is the built-in sensor that works out whether the consistency of your ice cream or frozen yogurt is right for you (from the 12 hardness settings) so that it can stop mixing when it’s ready, alerting you with a fun tune. As you’d expect from the considerable price tag, there’s a built-in freezer and it feels beautifully engineered.
paragraphs.translation:
这是一台非常智能的机器。
我们最喜欢的功能是内置传感器，它能判断你的冰淇淋或冷冻酸奶的质地是否达到你的要求（从12种硬度设置中选择），从而在准备好时停止搅拌，并用有趣的曲调提醒你。
正如你对高昂价格的期望，它配备了一个内置冷冻器，并且感觉做工精美。

paragraphs.text: D Lakeland Digital Ice Cream Maker
paragraphs.translation: D 拉克兰德数码冰淇淋机

paragraphs.text: You simply pop on the lid and pour in the ingredients, then set the timer using the nice, clear digital display. Some customers reportedly struggled to disassemble it in order to wash the bowl and paddle, but we didn’t have that problem. We’re also giving it extra points for the recipe book, which has some really tasty ideas.
paragraphs.translation:
你只需盖上盖子，倒入原料，然后通过清晰易懂的数字显示屏设定定时器。
据报道，一些顾客在拆卸机器以清洗碗和搅拌桨时遇到困难，但我们没有遇到这个问题。
我们还因附带的食谱书而给它加分，书中有一些非常美味的创意。

paragraphs.text: E Judge Ice Cream Maker
paragraphs.translation: E 法官冰淇淋机

paragraphs.text: We had a few criticisms, perhaps not surprisingly when you consider this is one of the cheapest models in our selection - notably the fact that the paddle isn’t as robust as the ones in other models. We’d have liked more recipes, too. But, for a budget machine, this is a bargain.
paragraphs.translation:
我们有一些批评意见，考虑到这是我们挑选的产品中最便宜的型号之一，这或许并不令人惊讶——尤其是其搅拌桨不如其他型号的坚固。
我们也希望有更多的食谱。
但就一款经济型机器而言，这非常划算。

paragraphs.text: F KitchenAid Artisan Ice Cream Maker
paragraphs.translation: F 厨房助手工匠冰淇淋机

paragraphs.text: If you own a KitchenAid food mixer, this attachment (one of 15 that fits this machine) is a good way to start ice cream making. You simply freeze the bowl before use and attach it to the mixer (a quick and easy job) and pour in your favourite fresh ingredients, with some recipes taking just 20 minutes.
paragraphs.translation:
如果你拥有一台KitchenAid食品搅拌机，这个配件（适配该机器的15种配件之一）是开始制作冰淇淋的一个好方法。
你只需在使用前冷冻碗体并将其安装到搅拌机上（一项快速简单的工作），然后倒入你喜爱的新鲜配料，有些食谱仅需20分钟即可完成。

paragraphs.text: Photography weekend course on the coast of Cornwall
paragraphs.translation: 康沃尔海岸摄影周末课程

paragraphs.text: Our three-night photography weekend is designed to appeal to all levels. Participants will be able to enjoy some of the fantastic locations on this beautiful coastline, with its ever-changing light, while staying in a comfortable hotel and enjoying some typical dishes of this south-western region of Britain.
paragraphs.translation:
我们的三天两晚摄影周末课程旨在吸引各个水平的参与者。
参与者将能够欣赏这条美丽海岸线上的一些绝佳地点，感受其不断变化的光线，同时入住舒适的酒店，并品尝英国西南部地区的特色菜肴。

paragraphs.text: Price includes: Personal daily tuition, discussions, welcome reception, and dinner, bed and breakfast for three nights in a twin or double room.
paragraphs.translation: 费用包含：个人每日指导、讨论会、欢迎招待会，以及在双床房或双人房中住宿三晚的晚餐、住宿和早餐。

paragraphs.text: Price does not include: Insurance and photographic equipment plus transport to photographic venues. Participants are required to arrange this. Car share during the weekend is a popular option.
paragraphs.translation:
价格不包括：保险、摄影设备以及往返摄影地点的交通费用。
参与者需自行安排这些事项。
在周末期间拼车是一种常见的选择。

paragraphs.text: Course information
paragraphs.translation: 课程信息

paragraphs.text: · Our courses are relaxed but comprehensive, and the content is largely dictated by those attending. Included within the sessions are editing workshops at the hotel and photo shoots down by the sea. Visits further away are also undertaken to experiment with different landscapes.
paragraphs.translation:
我们的课程既轻松又全面，并且内容主要由参与者决定。
课程环节包括在酒店的编辑工坊和在海边的摄影拍摄。
还会到更远的地方进行参观，以尝试不同的地貌景观。

paragraphs.text: · Arrival by mid-afternoon on the first day will allow you to check into the hotel and enjoy some Cornish refreshments before heading out into the fresh air for our first shoot together at sunset. Dinner and a good night’s sleep and you’ II be ready start at sunrise the next day.
paragraphs.translation: 第一天下午三点前到达，您将能够办理酒店入住并享用一些康沃尔小吃，然后在日落时分前往户外参加我们的第一次集体拍摄。

paragraphs.text: In the evenings you will have a chance to unwind at the hotel, share your thoughts on the day and spend time looking at images and sharing editing techniques.
paragraphs.translation: 晚上，您将有机会在酒店放松身心，分享一天的感想，并花时间欣赏照片和交流编辑技巧。

paragraphs.text: · Maximum numbers: Four photographers per course.
paragraphs.translation: · 最大人数：每门课程四名摄影师。

paragraphs.text: · The following equipment is essential: A digital SLR or bridge camera with its instruction manual, batteries and charger; memory cards; comfortable walking footwear with good grip; warm outdoor clothing and waterproofs.
paragraphs.translation: 以下设备是必需的：一台数码单反相机或桥式相机，配有说明书、电池和充电器；存储卡；具有良好抓地力的舒适步行鞋；保暖的户外服装和防水装备。

paragraphs.text: · Recommended equipment: A tripod, filters, a laptop with editing software and charger.
paragraphs.translation: · 推荐设备：三脚架、滤镜、配备编辑软件的笔记本电脑及充电器。

questions.reason: 题干与原文一致。

parts.title: Passage 2
parts.article_title: Respiratory Protective Equipment - advice for factory employees

paragraphs.text: You need to wear Respiratory Protective Equipment (RPE) when you’re doing work where you could breathe in hazardous substances in the air such as dust, vapor or gas. Common health effects from breathing hazardous substances include sore eyes and headaches.
paragraphs.translation:
当您从事的工作可能会吸入空气中的有害物质（如灰尘、蒸汽或气体）时，您需要佩戴呼吸防护设备（RPE）。
吸入有害物质常见的健康影响包括眼睛酸痛和头痛。

paragraphs.text: Make sure you are using the right RPE for the task. For example, negative pressure respirators should not be used in low oxygen environments.
paragraphs.translation:
确保你正在使用适合该任务的呼吸防护设备。
例如，负压呼吸器不应在低氧环境中使用。

paragraphs.text: Some types of RPE must have a tight seal around the facial area to be effective. Your employer will arrange a yearly facial fit test to ensure that you are given RPE that fits properly. This checks that the seal between the respirator and the facial area is secure, by releasing a substance that you can smell or taste if the RPE is not working properly. RPE will only provide effective protection if you are clean shaven. Facial hair growth makes it almost impossible to get a good seal so, if you have a beard, you should talk to your employer about other forms of RPE that do not rely on a tight facial fit. Jewellery and long hair can also compromise an effective fit.
paragraphs.translation:
某些类型的呼吸防护设备必须在面部区域形成紧密密封才能有效。
你的雇主将安排每年一次的面部密合性测试，以确保你获得合适的呼吸防护设备。
通过释放一种物质（如果呼吸防护设备无法正常工作，你就能闻到或尝到），这项测试检查呼吸器与面部区域之间的密封是否牢固。
只有当你剃净胡须时，呼吸防护设备才能提供有效保护。
面部毛发生长使得几乎无法获得良好密封，因此，如果你留有胡须，应与你雇主讨论不依赖面部紧密贴合的其他类型呼吸防护设备。
首饰和长发也可能影响有效的密合效果。

paragraphs.text: Using your RPE
paragraphs.translation: 使用您的呼吸防护设备

paragraphs.text: You should complete a visual check of your RPE for signs of damage before you use it. If you are using RPE that requires a tight fit, you must check it fits properly before entering a hazardous area.
paragraphs.translation:
在使用呼吸防护设备之前，应先对其进行目视检查，查看是否有损坏迹象。
如果你使用的是需要紧密贴合面部的呼吸防护设备，则必须在进入危险区域之前检查其是否佩戴妥当。

paragraphs.text: Cleaning your RPE
paragraphs.translation: 清洁您的呼吸防护设备

paragraphs.text: Wash your RPE after using it. Use a mild detergent, as harsh products such as solvents can cause damage. Use a brush and warm water and rinse with clean water. This will remove excess detergent that can cause skin irritation. Dry your RPE on a solid wooden rack or suspend from a clothesline.
paragraphs.translation:
使用后清洗您的呼吸防护设备。
使用温和的洗涤剂，因为溶剂等刺激性产品可能会造成损坏。
使用刷子和温水清洗，然后用清水冲洗干净。
这样可以去除可能导致皮肤刺激的多余洗涤剂。
将呼吸防护设备放在坚固的木架上晾干，或挂在晾衣绳上。

paragraphs.text: Maintaining your RPE
paragraphs.translation: 维护你的呼吸防护设备

paragraphs.text: Inspect your RPE after each use and during cleaning. Make sure you check the straps for breaks, tears, fraying edges and deterioration of elasticity. Check that the inhalation and exhalation valves are working and not damaged.
paragraphs.translation:
每次使用后及清洁过程中，检查您的呼吸防护设备。
确保检查束带是否有断裂、撕裂、边缘磨损以及弹性退化。
检查吸气和呼气阀是否正常工作且未损坏。

paragraphs.text: Storing your RPE
paragraphs.translation: 存放你的呼吸防护设备

paragraphs.text: Improper storage can cause distortion to your RPE. Store your RPE in a clean, dry place away from dust, oil and sunlight. RPE should be stored so that it doesn't get crushed.
paragraphs.translation:
不当的存放可能会导致您的呼吸防护装备变形。
请将您的呼吸防护装备存放在远离灰尘、油污和阳光的清洁干燥处。
呼吸防护装备的存放方式应确保其不会被压坏。

paragraphs.text: Working with cows in a dairy Guidelines for employers
paragraphs.translation: 在奶牛场与奶牛一起工作：雇主指南

paragraphs.text: Slips and trips
paragraphs.translation: 滑倒与绊倒

paragraphs.text: Slips and trips are one of the most common accidents when working in farm dairies. They often happen when working with cows in a dairy during milking, and during maintenance and cleaning. The following three hazards make it more likely that employees will slip or trip:
paragraphs.translation:
滑倒与绊倒
滑倒和绊倒是在农场牛奶场工作时最常见的事故之一。
这些事故通常发生在牛奶场与奶牛一起工作、挤奶期间，以及维护和清洁过程中。
以下三种危险因素会增加员工滑倒或绊倒的可能性：

paragraphs.text: 1. Surfaces which are wet or dirty
paragraphs.translation: 1. 潮湿或脏污的表面

paragraphs.text: · Have a system for cleaning up milk, oil, cleaning fluid and grain spills as soon as they happen, and make sure it is followed.
paragraphs.translation: · 建立一套系统，在牛奶、油污、清洁液和谷物泄漏发生时立即清理，并确保该流程得到遵守。

paragraphs.text: · Install non-slip mats in wet work areas and make sure that footwear is slip-resistant.
paragraphs.translation: 在潮湿的工作区域安装防滑垫，并确保鞋履具有防滑性能。

paragraphs.text: 2. Obstacles such as pipes or cables in the farm dairy
paragraphs.translation:
2.
农用奶牛场中的障碍物，例如管道或电缆

paragraphs.text: · Reduce tripping accidents by hanging hoses and pipes along walls out of people’s way and remove unused fittings, like bolt fasteners in floors.
paragraphs.translation: 通过沿墙悬挂软管和管道，使其不阻碍人员通行，并移除未使用的配件（如地板上的螺栓紧固件），以减少绊倒事故。

paragraphs.text: · Move obstacles from walkways and entrances where possible. Tripping hazards which cannot be removed should be clearly indicated with yellow tape. If there are obstacles overhead, these should be wrapped in padding to avoid risk of injury.
paragraphs.translation:
· 尽可能将障碍物从走道和入口处移开。
· 无法移除的绊倒危险物应使用黄色胶带清晰标示。
· 如果高处有障碍物，应包裹缓冲材料以避免受伤风险。

paragraphs.text: 3. Steps which are too high or not deep enough, or steps in poorly lit areas
paragraphs.translation: 3. 台阶过高或深度不足，或照明不佳区域的台阶

paragraphs.text: · Build steps properly and use non-slip surfaces.
paragraphs.translation: · 正确建造台阶并使用防滑表面。

paragraphs.text: · Handrails should also be fitted.
paragraphs.translation: · 还应安装扶手。

paragraphs.text: · The provision of good lighting can also help to reduce the risk of injury.
paragraphs.translation: · 提供良好的照明也有助于降低受伤风险。

paragraphs.text: Lifting and carrying
paragraphs.translation: 提举与搬运

paragraphs.text: The following tasks pose risks to dairy workers:
paragraphs.translation: 以下工作任务对乳品工人构成风险：

paragraphs.text: · lifting buckets of grain, water and milk
paragraphs.translation: · 提起装有谷物、水和牛奶的桶

paragraphs.text: · lifting calves.
paragraphs.translation: • 搬运小牛。

paragraphs.text: Managing the hazards
paragraphs.translation:
管理危害
管控危险因素

paragraphs.text: · Balance the load by using two buckets, one in each hand.
paragraphs.translation: · 通过双手各提一只桶来平衡负重。

paragraphs.text: · Where possible, use trolleys and other mechanical aids to replace manual tasks.
paragraphs.translation: · 在可能的情况下，使用手推车和其他机械辅助工具来替代人工操作。

paragraphs.text: Milking by hand
paragraphs.translation: 手工挤奶

paragraphs.text: Specific tasks in milking which cause injury are:
paragraphs.translation: 挤奶过程中导致伤害的具体任务包括：

paragraphs.text: · bending in an awkward position
paragraphs.translation: · 以别扭的姿势弯腰

paragraphs.text: · putting on and removing milking equipment from cows.
paragraphs.translation: · 给奶牛装上和取下挤奶设备。

paragraphs.text: Managing the hazards
paragraphs.translation:
管理危害
管控危险因素

paragraphs.text: · Think about designing or changing the milking area so workers can change the height they are working at to suit them. Ensure that all equipment needed is close by to avoid workers having to overreach or adopt a bending position.
paragraphs.translation:
· 考虑设计或改变挤奶区域，以便员工能够调整其作业高度以适应自身需求。
确保所有所需设备都在近处，以避免员工过度伸手或采取弯腰姿势。

paragraphs.text: · Alternate between jobs to reduce repetitious manual handling tasks, including a rotation between putting on and removing milking equipment.
paragraphs.translation: · 轮流执行不同工作以减少重复性体力操作任务，包括在安装和拆卸挤奶设备之间进行轮换。

parts.source_article_title: Respiratory Protective Equipment - advice for factory employees

sentence_translations.sentence: You need to wear Respiratory Protective Equipment (RPE) when you’re doing work where you could breathe in hazardous substances in the air such as dust, vapor or gas.
sentence_translations.translation: 当您从事的工作可能会吸入空气中的有害物质（如灰尘、蒸汽或气体）时，您需要佩戴呼吸防护设备（RPE）。

sentence_translations.sentence: Common health effects from breathing hazardous substances include sore eyes and headaches.
sentence_translations.translation: 吸入有害物质常见的健康影响包括眼睛酸痛和头痛。

sentence_translations.sentence: Make sure you are using the right RPE for the task.
sentence_translations.translation: 确保你正在使用适合该任务的呼吸防护设备。

sentence_translations.sentence: For example, negative pressure respirators should not be used in low oxygen environments.
sentence_translations.translation: 例如，负压呼吸器不应在低氧环境中使用。

sentence_translations.sentence: Some types of RPE must have a tight seal around the facial area to be effective.
sentence_translations.translation: 某些类型的呼吸防护设备必须在面部区域形成紧密密封才能有效。

sentence_translations.sentence: Your employer will arrange a yearly facial fit test to ensure that you are given RPE that fits properly.
sentence_translations.translation: 你的雇主将安排每年一次的面部密合性测试，以确保你获得合适的呼吸防护设备。

sentence_translations.sentence: This checks that the seal between the respirator and the facial area is secure, by releasing a substance that you can smell or taste if the RPE is not working properly.
sentence_translations.translation: 通过释放一种物质（如果呼吸防护设备无法正常工作，你就能闻到或尝到），这项测试检查呼吸器与面部区域之间的密封是否牢固。

sentence_translations.sentence: RPE will only provide effective protection if you are clean shaven.
sentence_translations.translation: 只有当你剃净胡须时，呼吸防护设备才能提供有效保护。

sentence_translations.sentence: Facial hair growth makes it almost impossible to get a good seal so, if you have a beard, you should talk to your employer about other forms of RPE that do not rely on a tight facial fit.
sentence_translations.translation: 面部毛发生长使得几乎无法获得良好密封，因此，如果你留有胡须，应与你雇主讨论不依赖面部紧密贴合的其他类型呼吸防护设备。

sentence_translations.sentence: Jewellery and long hair can also compromise an effective fit.
sentence_translations.translation: 首饰和长发也可能影响有效的密合效果。

sentence_translations.sentence: Using your RPE
sentence_translations.translation: 使用您的呼吸防护设备

sentence_translations.sentence: You should complete a visual check of your RPE for signs of damage before you use it.
sentence_translations.translation: 在使用呼吸防护设备之前，应先对其进行目视检查，查看是否有损坏迹象。

sentence_translations.sentence: If you are using RPE that requires a tight fit, you must check it fits properly before entering a hazardous area.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果你使用的是需要紧密贴合面部的呼吸防护设备，则必须在进入危险区域之前检查其是否佩戴妥当。

sentence_translations.sentence: Cleaning your RPE
sentence_translations.translation: 清洁您的呼吸防护设备

sentence_translations.sentence: Wash your RPE after using it.
sentence_translations.translation: 使用后清洗您的呼吸防护设备。

sentence_translations.sentence: Use a mild detergent, as harsh products such as solvents can cause damage.
sentence_translations.translation: 使用温和的洗涤剂，因为溶剂等刺激性产品可能会造成损坏。

sentence_translations.sentence: Use a brush and warm water and rinse with clean water.
sentence_translations.translation: 使用刷子和温水清洗，然后用清水冲洗干净。

sentence_translations.sentence: This will remove excess detergent that can cause skin irritation.
sentence_translations.translation: 这样可以去除可能导致皮肤刺激的多余洗涤剂。

sentence_translations.sentence: Dry your RPE on a solid wooden rack or suspend from a clothesline.
sentence_translations.translation: 将呼吸防护设备放在坚固的木架上晾干，或挂在晾衣绳上。

sentence_translations.sentence: Maintaining your RPE
sentence_translations.translation: 维护你的呼吸防护设备

sentence_translations.sentence: Inspect your RPE after each use and during cleaning.
sentence_translations.translation: 每次使用后及清洁过程中，检查您的呼吸防护设备。

sentence_translations.sentence: Make sure you check the straps for breaks, tears, fraying edges and deterioration of elasticity.
sentence_translations.translation: 确保检查束带是否有断裂、撕裂、边缘磨损以及弹性退化。

sentence_translations.sentence: Check that the inhalation and exhalation valves are working and not damaged.
sentence_translations.translation: 检查吸气和呼气阀是否正常工作且未损坏。

sentence_translations.sentence: Storing your RPE
sentence_translations.translation: 存放你的呼吸防护设备

sentence_translations.sentence: Improper storage can cause distortion to your RPE.
sentence_translations.translation: 不当的存放可能会导致您的呼吸防护装备变形。

sentence_translations.sentence: Store your RPE in a clean, dry place away from dust, oil and sunlight.
sentence_translations.translation: 请将您的呼吸防护装备存放在远离灰尘、油污和阳光的清洁干燥处。

sentence_translations.sentence: RPE should be stored so that it doesn't get crushed.
sentence_translations.translation: 呼吸防护装备的存放方式应确保其不会被压坏。

sentence_translations.sentence: Working with cows in a dairy Guidelines for employers
sentence_translations.translation: 在奶牛场与奶牛一起工作：雇主指南

sentence_translations.sentence: Slips and trips
sentence_translations.translation: 滑倒与绊倒

sentence_translations.sentence: Slips and trips are one of the most common accidents when working in farm dairies.
sentence_translations.translation: 滑倒和绊倒是在农场牛奶场工作时最常见的事故之一。

sentence_translations.sentence: They often happen when working with cows in a dairy during milking, and during maintenance and cleaning.
sentence_translations.translation: 这些事故通常发生在牛奶场与奶牛一起工作、挤奶期间，以及维护和清洁过程中。

sentence_translations.sentence: The following three hazards make it more likely that employees will slip or trip:
sentence_translations.translation: 以下三种危险因素会增加员工滑倒或绊倒的可能性：

sentence_translations.sentence: 1. Surfaces which are wet or dirty
sentence_translations.translation: 1. 潮湿或脏污的表面

sentence_translations.sentence: · Have a system for cleaning up milk, oil, cleaning fluid and grain spills as soon as they happen, and make sure it is followed.
sentence_translations.translation: · 建立一套系统，在牛奶、油污、清洁液和谷物泄漏发生时立即清理，并确保该流程得到遵守。

sentence_translations.sentence: Install non-slip mats in wet work areas and make sure that footwear is slip-resistant.
sentence_translations.translation: 在潮湿的工作区域安装防滑垫，并确保鞋履具有防滑性能。

sentence_translations.sentence: Obstacles such as pipes or cables in the farm dairy
sentence_translations.translation: 农用奶牛场中的障碍物，例如管道或电缆

sentence_translations.sentence: · Reduce tripping accidents by hanging hoses and pipes along walls out of people’s way and remove unused fittings, like bolt fasteners in floors.
sentence_translations.translation: 通过沿墙悬挂软管和管道，使其不阻碍人员通行，并移除未使用的配件（如地板上的螺栓紧固件），以减少绊倒事故。

sentence_translations.sentence: · Move obstacles from walkways and entrances where possible.
sentence_translations.translation: · 尽可能将障碍物从走道和入口处移开。

sentence_translations.sentence: Tripping hazards which cannot be removed should be clearly indicated with yellow tape.
sentence_translations.translation: · 无法移除的绊倒危险物应使用黄色胶带清晰标示。

sentence_translations.sentence: If there are obstacles overhead, these should be wrapped in padding to avoid risk of injury.
sentence_translations.translation: · 如果高处有障碍物，应包裹缓冲材料以避免受伤风险。

sentence_translations.sentence: 3. Steps which are too high or not deep enough, or steps in poorly lit areas
sentence_translations.translation: 3. 台阶过高或深度不足，或照明不佳区域的台阶

sentence_translations.sentence: · Build steps properly and use non-slip surfaces.
sentence_translations.translation: · 正确建造台阶并使用防滑表面。

sentence_translations.sentence: · Handrails should also be fitted.
sentence_translations.translation: · 还应安装扶手。

sentence_translations.sentence: · The provision of good lighting can also help to reduce the risk of injury.
sentence_translations.translation: · 提供良好的照明也有助于降低受伤风险。

sentence_translations.sentence: Lifting and carrying
sentence_translations.translation: 提举与搬运

sentence_translations.sentence: The following tasks pose risks to dairy workers:
sentence_translations.translation: 以下工作任务对乳品工人构成风险：

sentence_translations.sentence: · lifting buckets of grain, water and milk
sentence_translations.translation: · 提起装有谷物、水和牛奶的桶

sentence_translations.sentence: · lifting calves.
sentence_translations.translation: • 搬运小牛。

sentence_translations.sentence: Managing the hazards
sentence_translations.translation: 管理危害

sentence_translations.sentence: · Balance the load by using two buckets, one in each hand.
sentence_translations.translation: · 通过双手各提一只桶来平衡负重。

sentence_translations.sentence: · Where possible, use trolleys and other mechanical aids to replace manual tasks.
sentence_translations.translation: · 在可能的情况下，使用手推车和其他机械辅助工具来替代人工操作。

sentence_translations.sentence: Milking by hand
sentence_translations.translation: 手工挤奶

sentence_translations.sentence: Specific tasks in milking which cause injury are:
sentence_translations.translation: 挤奶过程中导致伤害的具体任务包括：

sentence_translations.sentence: · bending in an awkward position
sentence_translations.translation: · 以别扭的姿势弯腰

sentence_translations.sentence: · putting on and removing milking equipment from cows.
sentence_translations.translation: · 给奶牛装上和取下挤奶设备。

sentence_translations.sentence: Managing the hazards
sentence_translations.translation: 管控危险因素

sentence_translations.sentence: · Think about designing or changing the milking area so workers can change the height they are working at to suit them.
sentence_translations.translation: · 考虑设计或改变挤奶区域，以便员工能够调整其作业高度以适应自身需求。

sentence_translations.sentence: Ensure that all equipment needed is close by to avoid workers having to overreach or adopt a bending position.
sentence_translations.translation: 确保所有所需设备都在近处，以避免员工过度伸手或采取弯腰姿势。

sentence_translations.sentence: · Alternate between jobs to reduce repetitious manual handling tasks, including a rotation between putting on and removing milking equipment.
sentence_translations.translation: · 轮流执行不同工作以减少重复性体力操作任务，包括在安装和拆卸挤奶设备之间进行轮换。

As the most noticeable object in the night sky, the moon is an obvious subject when making your initial attempts at night photography. 在这样一个夜晚，满月只能反射大约百分之十的阳光，但这仍然足以照亮建筑物、树木、桥梁和其他景观特征。
作为夜空中最显眼的天体，月亮是你初次尝试夜间摄影时显而易见的目标。
了解傍晚月出的时间很重要，因为这不仅随一年中的时节而变化，而且月亮在此刻——离地平线最近时——看起来总是最大。

With today’s cameras, far greater detail can be rendered. 这是一种夜间摄影类型，十年前我们几乎没有人拥有合适的设备，但现在，由于技术的显著改进和价格变得可承受，所有摄影师都可以尝试了。

paragraphs.text: However, photographers choosing to shoot the moon may be less concerned by this, as they tend to prefer to use telephoto lenses to magnify the size of the moon, particularly when it is low in the sky and can be shown in relation to a landmark or recognisable structure within the frame.
